requests.name: Login
requests.description:
## POST /api/auth/login (Public)

### Request body
- email (string, required): User email. Example: user@example.com
- password (string, required): Account password. Example: password

### Success 200 data
- token (string): Sanctum bearer token. Example: 1|abc
- user (object): id, name, email, organization_name, locale (ar|en), theme (light|dark|system)

### Errors
- 401 invalid credentials
- 422 validation
- 429 rate limit

requests.name: Me
requests.description:
## GET /api/auth/me

Auth required.

### Response
- id (integer): User id. Example: 1
- name (string): Display name
- email (string): Login email
- organization_name (string, nullable): Organization
- locale (string): ar or en. Default ar
- theme (string): light, dark, or system. Default system
- email_verified_at (datetime, nullable)

### Errors
- 401 unauthenticated

requests.name: Get preferences
requests.description:
## GET /api/profile/preferences

### Response data
- locale (string, not nullable): Saved UI language. Values: ar, en. Example: ar. Business: frontend uses this to pick *_ar vs *_en and RTL/LTR.
- theme (string, not nullable): Saved color theme. Values: light, dark, system. Example: system. Business: frontend-only visual; backend stores it.

### Errors
- 401 unauthenticated

requests.name: Update preferences
requests.description:
## PATCH /api/profile/preferences

### Request body (all optional, send at least one)
- locale (string, optional): ar or en. Example: en
- theme (string, optional): light, dark, system. Example: dark

### Response data
- locale (string): Saved language
- theme (string): Saved theme

### Errors
- 401 unauthenticated
- 422 invalid locale or theme

requests.name: Questions
requests.description:
## GET /api/assessment/questions

### Response data
- total_questions (integer): Always 18 after seed. Example: 18
- pillars (array): Six readiness pillars.
  - id (integer)
  - key (string): team, funding, impact, partnerships, technology, sustainability
  - name_ar / name_en (string): Display names
  - description_ar / description_en (string, nullable en): Pillar meaning
  - questions (array of 3):
    - id (integer): Use in submit answers.question_id
    - text_ar / text_en (string): Question text
    - display_order (integer): 1-3 within pillar

### Errors
- 401 unauthenticated

requests.name: Start
requests.description:
## POST /api/assessment/start

No body. Resumes existing in_progress assessment if any.

### Response data
- assessment_id (integer): Id to submit against. Example: 7
- status (string, optional): in_progress when resuming

### Errors
- 401 unauthenticated

requests.name: Submit
requests.description:
## POST /api/assessment/{id}/submit

### Path
- id (integer, required): Assessment id from start

### Request body
- answers (array, required): Exactly 18 items
  - question_id (integer, required): Must exist, distinct
  - score (integer, required): 1-5 Likert

Business: scoring is rule-based. AI/PDF run after commit.

### Success data
- assessment_id (integer)

### Errors
- 401 unauthenticated
- 403 not owner
- 422 size != 18, score out of range, already completed

requests.name: Results
requests.description:
## GET /api/assessment/{id}/results

### data.assessment
- overall_score (number): 0-100 average of 6 pillars. Example: 60
- readiness_level (string): low if <50, medium if <70, else good
- readiness_level_ar / readiness_level_en (string)
- ai_summary_ar (string, nullable): Linguistic summary only
- ai_ready / pdf_ready (boolean)

### data.pillar_results[]
- percentage (number), is_weak (boolean): true for weakest 3
- pillar_name_ar / pillar_name_en

### data.action_plan.phases.{immediate,medium,long}.items[]
- id (integer): Use in PATCH action-plan/items/{id}
- action_ar / action_en (string): Rule text
- kpi_ar / kpi_en (string): Rule KPIs, never AI
- ai_rephrased_ar / ai_rephrased_en (string, nullable): Display fallback to action_*
- status (string): not_started | in_progress | completed

### Errors
- 403 not owner
- 422 not completed yet

requests.name: Update item status
requests.description:
## PATCH /api/action-plan/items/{id}

### Path
- id (integer, required): Action plan item id from results

### Request body
- status (string, required): not_started | in_progress | completed. Example: in_progress. Business: user progress on a rule-based task; does not change scores.

### Response data
- id (integer)
- status (string)
- status_ar (string): لم تبدأ / قيد التنفيذ / مكتملة
- status_en (string): Not started / In progress / Completed

### Errors
- 401 unauthenticated
- 403 not owner of parent assessment
- 404 missing item
- 422 invalid status

requests.name: List
requests.description:
## GET /api/expansion-areas

Returns only the authenticated user's map pins.

### data.items[]
- id (integer)
- name_ar (string): Arabic place name. Example: الرياض
- name_en (string, nullable): English name. Example: Riyadh
- lat (number): Latitude -90..90. Example: 24.7136
- lng (number): Longitude -180..180. Example: 46.6753
- notes (string, nullable): Optional context
- created_at / updated_at (datetime)

### Errors
- 401 unauthenticated

requests.name: Create
requests.description:
## POST /api/expansion-areas

### Request body
- name_ar (string, required, max 255)
- name_en (string, optional, max 255)
- lat (number, required, -90 to 90)
- lng (number, required, -180 to 180)
- notes (string, optional, max 2000)

### Success 201: same item object as list.

### Errors
- 401, 422 invalid coordinates or missing name_ar

requests.name: Update
requests.description:
## PATCH /api/expansion-areas/{id}

Same fields as create, all optional. 403 if another user's area. 404 if missing.

requests.name: Delete
requests.description:
## DELETE /api/expansion-areas/{id}

403 if not owner. 404 if missing. Success message only.

requests.name: PDF status
requests.description:
## GET /api/report/{assessment_id}/status

### Response data
- assessment_id (integer)
- pdf_ready (boolean): Whether download will succeed
- ai_ready (boolean): Whether summary exists. False is valid fallback, scores still stand.
- download_via (string): Instruction. Frontend MUST call GET /api/report/{id}/download with Bearer. No public storage URL is returned.

### Errors
- 401, 403

requests.name: PDF download
requests.description:
## GET /api/report/{assessment_id}/download

Binary PDF. Save as blob in frontend.

### Errors
- 403 not owner
- 422 pdf not generated yet
- 404 file missing on disk
